MappingPage | baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
|-- MappingPocPage
|   `-- MappingServicesContext -> MappingWorkspacePage
|       |-- diagrams: DiagramService [G]
|       |-- canvasHistory: CanvasHistoryService [E]
|       `-- workspaceStorage or new WorkspaceStorage
|-- CanvasWorkspace | owns session lifetimes
|   |-- drafts: Record<documentId, CanvasDraft>
|   |   |-- metadata
|   |   |   |-- name / savedName / representationId / revisionId
|   |   |   |-- savedScene / savedEdges
|   |   |   `-- busy / hidden / newerRevision / viewport / focusBox
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController [D]
|   |       |-- readable stores | immutable references
|   |       |   |-- document
|   |       |   |-- presentation: display + diagramViews
|   |       |   |-- selection / controls
|   |       |   |-- geometry: endpointBounds / cell / version
|   |       |   `-- status: isDirty / sceneDirty / canUndo / canRedo
|   |       `-- onCommit when canvasRevisionId changes
|   |-- controllers: Map<documentId, controller>
|   |-- changes.version / dirtyScenes.ids / onPersist(ids)
|   `-- setDrafts: create, subscribe, update baseline, dispose
|-- Controller-owned state
|   |-- MappingGridDocument
|   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene [A]
|   |   |   |-- root: GridBox | nested layout ownership
|   |   |   `-- contents: Record<contentId, Diagram> [B]
|   |   |-- edges: DiagramConnection[]
|   |   |-- jumps?: CanvasJump[]
|   |   `-- sections: contentId -> section[]
|   |-- MappingCanvasState
|   |   |-- selection: SelectionState.items
|   |   |   |-- whole instance: displayNodeId
|   |   |   `-- captured region: ASCII / revision / rect / selectedIds
|   |   |-- diagramViews: per-instance subtree folds
|   |   |-- display: DisplayState
|   |   |   |-- rootIds + nodes: Record<id, FloatingPane> [C]
|   |   |   `-- childIds form the display ownership tree
|   |   `-- controls: MappingControls
|   |       |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|   |       `-- surfaces: selection ID -> SelectionSurfaceState
|   |           |-- actions / presentation / projectionChoice
|   |           `-- prompt / ask / phase / status
|   `-- ControllerSnapshot
|       |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
|       `-- document / canvas / endpointBounds / cell / undo flags
|-- canvasDisplayNodes() | derived read-only registry
|   |-- grid:<boxId> | diagram or group
|   |   |-- geometry.units = cells; absolute bounds
|   |   `-- content / contentNodes / diagram / subtree folds
|   |-- floating:<id> | persisted FloatingPane
|   |   |-- geometry.units = pixels; canvas or viewport
|   |   `-- placement: grid-region / parent / conversation / stored
|   `-- floating:edge:<id> | drawEdge(document.edges)
|       `-- derived arrow; placement = connection
|-- View and rendering
|   |-- SourcePaneViewState
|   |   |-- live scroll by document + pane + source
|   |   |-- live camera by document
|   |   `-- captureDisplay / captureCamera / flush
|   |-- mounted document -> DraggableDiagramCanvas
|   |   `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
|   |       `-- update / transfer / undo / jump / busy callbacks
|   |-- MappingDiagramExplorer | diagrams + changes
|   |-- DiagramSearchService -> DiagramSearchPanel
|   |   `-- saved, draft and proposal documents; revision/hash checks
|   |-- ChangeSessionPreview
|   `-- DiagramEditCoordinator -> DiagramEditComposer
|-- Agent access
|   `-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand [D]
|-- Workspace persistence [E]
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence | session deltas + sampled view
|   |-- RecordStorage | cache / pending / transport batches
|   |-- WorkspaceStorage | one worker per workspace
|   `-- MappingWorkspaceSnapshot | schemaVersion: 3
|       |-- projectId / activeDocumentId / transfers
|       `-- documents: metadata + document + canvas + history + viewport
|-- Page coordination
|   |-- activeId / mountedDocuments / workspaceEpoch
|   |-- project representations + saved revision catalog
|   |-- open: documentFromRevision + historyFromRevision
|   |-- save: captured scene / edges / history / expectedRevisionId
|   |   `-- acknowledgement updates captured baseline
|   |-- copyDocument: fork history; clear selection + controls
|   |   `-- retain conversation messages; pending = false
|   |-- transfer: copy or move selected whole diagrams [E]
|   |   `-- persist both histories + transaction before installation
|   |-- restore / import / export workspace
|   `-- delete: retire linked transfers + remove document records
`-- Ownership boundaries
    |-- selection membership belongs to SelectionState
    |-- focus and action surfaces belong to controls
    |-- live scroll/camera belongs to SourcePaneViewState
    `-- history contexts and services are runtime handles
